TerminalBasis.description: Whether a terminal value is a value of the whole business or of its equity.

oneOf.description:
Enterprise value: flows to all capital providers (FCFF), discounted at the WACC;
multiples EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales.

Equity value: flows to shareholders (FCFE, dividends), discounted at the cost of
equity; multiple P/E.

tax_on_gains.description: Tax on gains, in currency units, as given.

terminal_value.description:
Net liquidation value at N, not discounted, in currency units; negative when the
liabilities and costs exceed the realisable values.

total_assets.description: Sum of the realisable values of the assets, in currency units.

total_liabilities.description: Sum of the liabilities, in currency units.

total_liquidation_costs.description: Sum of the liquidation costs, in currency units.
